entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NullReferenceException trying to create a RuntimeType #136256
  • JIT crash (SIGSEGV) in `Compiler::fgCreateGCPoll` when recompiling a method at tier 1 with dynamic PGO #136255
  • [wasm] CQ: Lack of Implicit Tail Calls Leads to Size-Expensive GDV Expansion #136246
    12.0.0
  • Linux: concurrent named-mutex creation fails with mkdirat(...) == -1; errno == ENOENT on 10.0.13 (PAL rename replaces another process's .dotnet/shm) #136236
  • JIT: `p[i] += x` through a pointer keeps the element address in a register instead of using an addressing mode #136228
    Future
  • Concurrent XmlSerializer.Deserialize with separate XmlNodeReaders over a shared XmlDocument can corrupt NameTable and spin indefinitely #136227
  • Socket.SendFileAsync on Linux faults with ConnectionReset or SocketError instead of OperationAborted when the socket is disposed during the send #136224
  • Workstation GC writes to an uncommitted bookkeeping page under a heap hard limit; request .NET 10 backport #136222
  • [HTTP] Cookies RFC update #136219
    12.0.0
  • Deadlock in the PAL between MAPMapPEFile and VirtualQuery on macOS arm64 #136217
  • ZipArchive should report better error message for empty or invalid stream #136215
  • TlsSession client on macOS does not send its configured client certificate #136213
  • baseservices/threading/DeadThreads fails with stack overflow #136204
  • NativeAOT shared library on linux-x64: first call into an [UnmanagedCallersOnly] export whose frame has a GS cookie (e.g. stackalloc) aborts the process #136201
  • Hot reload: a static field added by EnC to a type in a collectible AssemblyLoadContext is read and written at the wrong address #136199
  • Test failure: tracing/eventpipe/eventsvalidation/SampleProfilerSampleType/SampleProfilerSampleType.cmd #136197
  • Test failure: global::Runtime_136000.TestEntryPoint() #136196
  • [9.0][browser] BuildThenPublishWithAOT times out after logging result 42 #136193

Closed

  • release/10.0 is not building due to System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs vulnerability warnings-as-errors. #136231
  • release/10.0 is not building due to a MsQuic Schannel dependency warning-as-error. #136232
  • [wasm][R2R] DevDiv_902271 reads GC static out of bounds #133467
  • ThreadAbortException raised again after a catch can skip a finally and reaches different handlers in tier-0 and optimized code #135637
    12.0.0
  • Avoid preserving live values across non-returning throw-helper calls #136242
  • Cannot use Properties with $-character when reading System.Text.Json metadata. #79482
    Future
  • NativeAOT linux-x64: GC return-address hijack corrupts the caller's frame when a thread is suspended in the epilogue of a self-recursive fast tail call #135912
  • Test failure: JIT/opt/GuardedDevirtualization/badinlinee/badinlinee.cmd #135557
    12.0.0
  • Blazor WASM AOT Compilation Failure #132071
    10.0.x
  • System.Net.Security.Tests.TlsSessionTests fail with timeouts #136205
  • NativeAOT MethodInvoker.Invoke(object, Span<object>) throws InvalidOperationException instead of TargetParameterCountException for a wrong argument count on an open generic method #136102
  • [browser] HotReload functional test is built but not submitted to Helix in CI #136150
  • ILVerify reports MethodAccess when a type calls a protected member of an interface it implements #136175
  • Revisit ImmutableExtensions.TryCopyTo behavior for ICollection<T> #88181
    Future
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `runtime/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #136195
  • COM IDispatch property setters throw COMException (0x80020005) starting from .NET 11 Preview 4 #136137
  • [C++/CLI] Direct access of unmanaged thread_local variable from managed code causes unexpected NullReferenceException #42187
    Future
  • Checked build JIT assertion (`pfnHelper != NULL`) when accessing `__declspec(thread)` TLS from IJW/C++CLI managed entry points #133538
    Future
